Owner identity and backend authorization do not automatically unlock Run Farm, Approve, Promote, Sign, or Publish. Each action stays fail-closed until its dedicated capability wiring is complete.
This build does not have a GitHub App Client ID configured yet. Add the real public Client ID, not an App ID or Installation ID.
The value entered is the Source Lab Installation ID, not the GitHub App Client ID. Installation ID 162045953 must never be sent to GitHub Device Flow as a client ID.
The value entered is the numeric GitHub App ID, not the Client ID. Device Flow requires the public Client ID.
The GitHub Client ID is invalid. A Client ID is an alphanumeric public identifier and is not a numeric App/Installation ID.
GitHub Device Flow returned an unexpected endpoint error. Source Lab no longer uses GitHub App slug discovery.
GitHub owner authorization failed. The security gate remains closed; retry after checking the Client ID and GitHub App configuration.
